Key takeaways (short):
- Most ICs: minor adjustments (move within band, no promotion) based on cross-team context.
- Two outliers on Eng infra (IDs E-432, E-447): proposed upward adjustment to account for stretch deliverables — proposal attached but flagged for 1:1 review.
- One leadership candidate (S. Ortega): recorded recommendation for calibration with MCC (requires HR concurrence).

Asks: please review the attached and confirm within 24 hours if you: approve, request a 1:1 recalibration, or want to escalate. I'll merge approvals and send to PeopleOps for formal recording and comp planning.

Action log preview (I'll update the Drive link after approvals):
1) Merge approved changes -> PeopleOps intake by EOD 11/6
2) Hold adjustments for E-432 & E-447 pending manager 1:1s (owners: Lauren, Mina)
3) Leadership candidate -> schedule calibration with MCC & HR (owner: Marcus)

Thanks — short and focused.

Marcus Lin

Marcus — thanks for pulling this together. Quick notes: 
- I reviewed the two infra cases. For E-432 there was a late pivot in scope that materially affected delivery; I support the upward adjustment but only after a short 1:1 to ensure artifacts match the claim (code review timestamps, release notes).
- E-447 I am not comfortable approving an upward move yet. Manager's write-up feels like it conflates team-level reliability improvements with individual stretch. Requesting a 15–20m calibration call with the manager before approval.

If we push these through without 1:1s we'll risk inconsistency during comp calibration. Otherwise, approve the rest of the sheet for PeopleOps intake.
